name: Pokhozhdeniya bravogo soldata Shveyka
storyline:
Do you know Švejk? He is the soldier who was declared unfit for military service due to idiocy, yet he is also the one who, strangely, can get away with everything he does.
Do you know why? No? We will tell you!
So, on an early August morning in 1914, Josef Švejk wakes up at home, where he is overtaken by the news of the assassination of Archduke Ferdinand. Europe is on the eve of war, but Pan Josef has his own opinion on ​​the balance of forces and power alliances. And what's the matter - it's up to you, the gentlemen of the players, to find out.
